_comment: Six-Hour Gate — alarm triage policy. Tunable without a code change.

timezone._comment: Sri Lanka UTC+5:30. Prefer the per-plant value from queryPlants -> address.timezone (seconds); this is the fallback only.

_r4_withdrawn: R4 removed 13 Sep 2026. Offline is detected by the 3-day production-loss rule (an offline logger writes 0.0000 rows, which trips RED), so the gate needs no offline digest and no offline-plant suppression of its own.
_r5_withdrawn: R5 removed 12 Oct 2026. Battery (SOC) alarms are on the same six-hour clock as every other class; there is no daylight window. To quieten one class, give it a longer dwell_hours.

COMMS._comment: Never mailed — customer's network, not our equipment. Not reported here either: a logger that stays down surfaces as a 3-day production-loss RED alert on the CSV side.

SILENT._comment: UC22 only: a SOLARMAN inverter that has sent nothing. Unlike COMMS it IS mailed (the owner's decision, 11 Nov 2026): SOLARMAN's Alerts tab reports nothing, so silence is the only sign of an inverter that has died or been switched off. Its messages avoid every COMMS word, so this class wins.

escalation_hint.GRID: Grid absent 6h+ — check the AC input breaker before blaming CEB.
escalation_hint.SOC: Battery alarm open 6h+ — check strings, charge controller and pack health.
escalation_hint.SILENT: No data from the inverter 6h+ — ask the customer whether it is switched on, then check the logger stick and the Wi-Fi.
escalation_hint.LOAD: Load alarm open 6h+ — check whether the house has been put on the changeover (bypass) and the inverter left idle.
escalation_hint.COMMS: Datalogger offline — customer-side network. Not mailed from here; a sustained outage surfaces as a 3-day production-loss alert.

match._comment: Lowercased substring match against the vendor's message. LONGEST PATTERN WINS, so 'overload time out' beats 'overload'. Anything unmatched falls to UNKNOWN and is logged.
match._comment_must: 'backup failed' and 'battery flat' are the MUST telemetry alarms' own words (UC20): made from the inverters' readings, not sent by any vendor.
match._comment_solarman: 'has sent nothing to solarman', 'inverter output is off', 'inverter fault' and 'not on the inverter' are UC22's own words, made from SOLARMAN readings. 'battery connection is open' is shared with ShineMonitor's SRNE text on purpose.
match._comment_deye: Deye Cloud alert names (UC19), as the fleet's alert lists wrote them Oct-Nov 2026: F-code and name run together ('F47AC_OverFreq_Fault') or apart ('AC_UnderFreq_Fault F48'), and 'NoUtillity' and 'U nderVolt' are Deye's own spellings. Matched on the name, never the code: Deye's alertCode repeats across protocol words. Not yet placed, so UNKNOWN: F59 AC_V_GridCurr_High, F57 AC_BackFeed, a bare 'F13'.
match._comment_solax: SolaX Cloud alarmName (UC21), as the fleet's alarm lists wrote them 2024-2026: GridVoltFault, GridFreqFault, GridLostFault, GridVolt10MFault, Ac10Mins_Voltage_Fault, GRID_PHS_LOSS, GRID_LOSS, GRID_UNBLC, GRID_UVP3 (all grid) and ResidualOCP (leakage current, hardware). Anything else falls to UNKNOWN and is still mailed.
SOC: solar charger stops due to low battery
HARDWARE: inverter bus voltage is too low
solar charger battery voltage class error
LOAD: solar charger stops due to over load
PV: solar charger stops due to high pv voltage

vendor_codes._comment: Where a portal gives a numeric code, match on it first — it is stabler than the message string. Incomplete; grow it from real UNKNOWN traffic.

solis._comment: 101x are grid faults as Solis words them: 1010 OV-G-V, 1011 UV-G-V/UN-G-V, 1012 OV-G-F, 1013 UN-G-F, 1015 NO-Grid, 1019 Uac-Unstable. 1D4C2 is SolisCloud's own 'Loss of internet connection'. Seen in the fleet's alarmList, Oct 2026.

solax._comment: SolaX errorCode. 1 GridLostFault, 2 GridVoltFault, 3 GridFreqFault, 7 GridVolt10MFault / Ac10Mins_Voltage_Fault, 91 GRID_LOSS, 102 GRID_PHS_LOSS, 103 GRID_UNBLC, 108 GRID_UVP3 are grid; 11 ResidualOCP is leakage current. The code differs by inverter generation, so the name map above is the fallback.
